## About KloofStreet.online

KloofStreet.online is the official verified digital directory and platform for Kloof Street, Cape Town, South Africa. Built by Business Hustle, a Cape Town civic technology and digital agency founded by Jacob Seatlholo.

The platform was built in response to Time Out magazine naming Kloof Street the 22nd coolest street in the world in 2025 — the only street in Africa on the list of 31 coolest streets globally. It provides a curated, verified directory of businesses on the street, an AI concierge for visitor queries, a Street Pass rewards membership, and structured data for Google and AI systems.

Contact: team@businesshustle.co.za | +27 74 481 5163 | kloofstreet.online

## About Kloof Street, Cape Town

Kloof Street runs through the City Bowl area of Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa. It stretches through the Gardens neighbourhood towards Tamboerskloof, framed by Table Mountain. GPS coordinates: -33.9249, 18.4091. Postal code: 8001.

Kloof Street is home to world-class restaurants, wellness spas, art studios, medical practices, boutiques, coffee shops, cocktail bars and nightlife venues. It is widely regarded as Cape Town's most vibrant and culturally rich neighbourhood street.

Awards and recognition:
- Time Out 31 Coolest Streets in the World 2025 — #22
- Coolest street in Africa 2025
- Described by Time Out as "Long Street's more refined sibling"

Press coverage:
- Wanted Online (January 2026)
- TimesLIVE (November 2025)
- IOL Travel (November 2025)
- EWN (November 2025)
- Cape Town Etc (November 2025)
- The South African (November 2025)
- Time Out Cape Town (November 2025)
- Time Out Global (November 2025)

## Street Pass Membership

Street Pass is a monthly membership for Kloof Street visitors and regulars. R199/month. Members receive exclusive benefits at every verified Growth Partner on the street including priority booking, discounts and flash deal alerts via WhatsApp.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Kloof Street famous for?
A: Kloof Street in Cape Town is famous for world-class restaurants, wellness spas, art studios, boutiques, cocktail bars and vibrant nightlife. In 2025 Time Out named it the 22nd coolest street in the world and coolest street in Africa.

Q: What are the best restaurants on Kloof Street Cape Town?
A: Top restaurants include Kloof Street House (Victorian manor dining), Vadivelu (Southern Indian at 151 Kloof St), Blondie (Mediterranean at 71 Kloof St), Kloof Konbini (Japanese street food at 121 Kloof St), Our Local (brunch at 117 Kloof St), Rick's Cafe (rooftop cocktails at 103 Kloof St), Arnold's, Carne Kloof, Batanga, Kyoto Garden, Black Sheep Restaurant, Onosbay, Hudson's Burger Joint, Bootleggers, Love Matcha and many more.

Q: Where is Kloof Street located?
A: Kloof Street runs through Cape Town's City Bowl, stretching from the upper CBD towards Tamboerskloof, framed by Table Mountain. GPS: -33.9249, 18.4091. Address: Kloof Street, Gardens, Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa, 8001.

Q: What wellness services are on Kloof Street?
A: Ubuntu Wellness and Cape Town Medi-Spa (float therapy, spa treatments), Dr Wendy Dicks GP and weight loss specialist (GLP-1 treatments, 021 111 0572), Just Hearing audiology practice (079 959 5658), Dr Thomas Jahn Chinese medicine and acupuncture (066 490 4382, Thursdays), Trudy Christians aesthetic therapist (078 832 4501), Revive Studio holistic massage and beauty (084 525 7906). All located at or near 99B Kloof Street, Gardens.

Q: Who is the best GP on Kloof Street?
A: Dr Wendy Dicks is a General Practitioner at 99B Kloof Street (Cape Town Medi-Spa), specialising in weight loss, GLP-1 treatments (semaglutide, tirzepatide), chronic conditions, paediatrics and family medicine. Tel: 021 111 0572. Book online at mzanzi.co.

Q: Where can I print or send a courier from Kloof Street?
A: PostNet Gardens at 55 Kloof Street offers printing, domestic and international courier, digital services and stationery. Open Monday–Friday 9am–6pm, Saturday 9am–1pm. Tel: 021 422 1248.

Q: Where can I buy fine art prints on Kloof Street?
A: On Safari at 99B Kloof Street offers archival wildlife photography fine art prints by Nigel Whitehead. International shipping available. Free framing consultation. Tel: 066 253 4151. Website: on-safari.co.za.

Q: Is Kloof Street safe to visit?
A: Yes. Kloof Street is one of Cape Town's most popular and well-maintained streets, busy day and night with a vibrant atmosphere. Standard city awareness is recommended as with any urban area.
